metadata.source_note: Original 26-page promulgated act, downloaded through the official public Xaver session and retained byte-for-byte. The PDF is image-only; German Tesseract OCR supplies extracted text. Article 1 no.1 introduces BGB 1591; Article 17 section 1 states commencement on 1 July 1998. Article 15 and EGBGB Article 224 require separate transitional analysis; this receipt does not claim applicability to every earlier birth. Key source spans are visually checked against the retained pages.
metadata.title: Gesetz zur Reform des Kindschaftsrechts (Kindschaftsrechtsreformgesetz – KindRG), 16. Dezember 1997, BGBl. I S. 2942–2967
